_comment: Researched 2026-11-19. One file for The Last of Us (PS3, June 14, 2013), Left Behind (2014), The Last of Us Remastered (PS4, 2014), Part II (PS4, June 19, 2020), Part I (PS5 2022, PC 2023) and Part II Remastered (PS5 January 19, 2024; PC April 3, 2025). releaseDate is April 3, 2025: Part II Remastered on PC, the most recent release of the pair (announced at The Game Awards 2024; PlayStation Blog, Engadget, Gematsu). No newer release exists as of today: Naughty Dog said in September 2026 that new Last of Us projects are only in early development. Names from both games as covered by Wikipedia and the Last of Us wiki. Overlap: the HBO show The Last of Us adapts the same story with the same character names, so first names (Joel, Ellie, Abby, Tommy, Dina, Jesse, Tess, Bill, Frank, Sarah, Marlene, Riley, Henry, Sam, David, Lev, Yara, Owen, Mel, Manny, Nora, Isaac, Jerry, Maria) are weak, as are ordinary words and real places (Fireflies, Wolves, Scars, Clickers, Bloaters, Rat King, Cordyceps, Jackson, Seattle, Santa Barbara, Salt Lake City, Pittsburgh, Left Behind). The aliases 'The Last of Us' and 'TLOU' are kept strong even though they also name the show: the show retells the games' plot, so show posts are game spoilers. Full names (Joel Miller, Ellie Williams, Abby Anderson, Tommy Miller) stay strong. Show actors (Pedro Pascal, Bella Ramsey, Kaitlyn Dever...) are left out; game voice actors (Troy Baker, Ashley Johnson, Laura Bailey, Shannon Woodward, Jeffrey Pierce, Merle Dandridge, Ian Alexander, Victoria Grace) are weak (Merle Dandridge also plays Marlene in the show). Accounts: @Naughty_Dog (studio; it also posts about Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet, which the studio says it will not show until 2027). @PlayStation and the HBO show's account are left out. Handle from coverage; verified status not checked live. Trimmed 2026-11-19 by the main session: removed very common first names, real cities, Marvel/mythology overlaps and famous actors (Bill, Frank, Henry, Sam, David, Maria, Sarah, Jesse, Mel, Manny, Nora, Isaac, Jerry, Owen, Jackson, Seattle, Santa Barbara, Salt Lake City, Pittsburgh, Wolves, Scars, Rattlers, Firefly, Fireflies), and generic backup words, so ordinary posts are not covered. releaseDate changed 2026-11-19 by the main session to the first game (The Last of Us, PS3, June 14 2013): it is only shown in the popup, and a 2025 remaster date read as if the games were new.
